pollInterval.title: Poll interval (ms)
pollInterval.description: How often each light is polled for state. The Elgato firmware has no push API. Minimum 1000 ms.

colorDebounce.title: Color debounce (ms)
colorDebounce.description: Controllers send hue and saturation as two separate commands; they are coalesced into one write after this delay.

enableMdns.title: Enable mDNS discovery
enableMdns.description: Browse _elg._tcp for Elgato lights. Turn off to use only the manual device list.

devices.title: Manual devices
devices.description: Lights to add by address, for networks where mDNS does not work. Host may include a port. Name is optional and overrides the name set in the Elgato app.

whiteList.title: White list
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black list
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

debug.title: Enable debug
debug.description: Enable the debug logging for this plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister on shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Use only for testing.
